title: Fuzzy OWL 2 Reasoning: A Re-Engineered Python Framework
summary: In many real-world domains, knowledge is inherently vague or imprecise - features that classical ontology languages, based on crisp Description Logics (DLs), are unable to capture. This shortcoming poses particular challenges for applications in the Semantic Web and Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), where robust reasoning over graded information is essential. Fuzzy ontologies address this limitation by enriching DLs with fuzzy logic, enabling the expression of partial truth and supporting more nuanced modelling of real-world knowledge.
